rationale: N-limited growth on amino acid fermentation. Oxidize branched and aromatic amino acids (Phe, Tyr, Val, Ile) and reduce small amino acids (Gly, Ser, Lys) via Stickland pathways, producing acetate, butyrate, formate, and CO₂. Ammonium release from deamination. Acetate co-uptake for energy. Growth constrained by NH₄⁺ (1.2 mM) and amino acid depletion.
